answer: One defence is Shipwright apprenticeship indenture with guild warden attestation: each indenture is years of yard work signed off by the guild warden, so a farm must apprentice a hundred real shipwrights, and the garden of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. Running a hundred clones would mean a hundred separate proofs, each costing real money and real time, and the mesa of that bill is larger than anything one epoch pays out. The wharf is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
